items.question: Is Lauren Jackson from Australia?
items.answer: Yes. Lauren Jackson is from Albury, New South Wales. She won five Olympic medals for Australia, silver in 2000, 2004 and 2008 and bronze in 2012 and 2024, and in 2021 became the first Australian player inducted into the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame.

items.question: What WNBA team did Lauren Jackson play for?
items.answer: Lauren Jackson played her entire WNBA career with the Seattle Storm, who made her the first pick of the 2001 WNBA Draft. She won WNBA championships with Seattle in 2004 and 2010.

items.question: Did Lauren Jackson play with Sue Bird?
items.answer: Yes. Sue Bird and Lauren Jackson were longtime Seattle Storm teammates and won the WNBA championship together in 2004 and 2010.

items.question: What were Lauren Jackson's WNBA career averages?
items.answer: Lauren Jackson averaged 18.9 points, 7.7 rebounds and 1.4 assists per game over her WNBA career, according to her WNBA.com profile.

items.question: How many MVP awards did Lauren Jackson win?
items.answer: Three. Lauren Jackson was WNBA MVP in 2003, 2007 and 2010, and Finals MVP in 2010. She was also the 2007 Defensive Player of the Year.
